dry_run.description: True when the agent ran the job on the recording runtime (sandbox_runtime = "fake"): nothing was started and nothing is captured. The control plane marks the decoy as a dry run (#91). Omitted when false.

failure_code.description: Machine-readable cause of a failed outcome. egress_unverified: the host could not confirm that new outbound connections from the decoy network are blocked, so it did not start the decoy (#93).
